install: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && if ! python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 12) else 1)' 2>/dev/null && command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv python install 3.12 && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && ln -sfn "$(uv python find 3.12)" "$HOME/.local/bin/python3" && ln -sfn "$(uv python find 3.12)" "$HOME/.local/bin/python"; fi && if [ -x /usr/bin/google-chrome ] && ! /usr/bin/google-chrome --headless=new --dump-dom about:blank >/dev/null 2>&1; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec /usr/bin/google-chrome --no-sandbox "$@"\n' > "$HOME/.local/bin/google-chrome" && chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/google-chrome"; fi && (sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true) && (grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc")
